variable_coverage.construction: Current worldwide tax expense, defined by the authors as Compustat TXT minus TXDI, scaled by total assets. If TXWW is missing while TXFED and TXFO are observed, the source sets TXWW = TXFED + TXFO. Formula: (TXT − TXDI) / AT; if missing and TXFED and TXFO are observed, TXWW = TXFED + TXFO.. Required raw sources: req_comp_tax.

Worldwide pretax income (Compustat PI), scaled by total assets. The source imputes PI as PIDOM + PIFO when PI is missing and both components are available. Formula: PI / AT; if missing and PIDOM and PIFO are observed, PI = PIDOM + PIFO.. Required raw sources: req_comp_tax.

Product of PI (Worldwide pretax income (Compustat PI), scaled by total assets. The source imputes PI as PIDOM + PIFO when PI is missing and both components are available.) and HAVENYEAR (Indicator equal to one if the firm reported at least one material operation in a country classified as a tax haven in year t, and zero otherwise. The static haven list classifies countries identified by at least three of four cited sources as of March 4, 2008.). The authors subtract the mean of all continuous variables before estimating the interaction model; this product is formed from the specified terms, with only continuous components subject to that centering. Formula: PI × HAVENYEAR. This indicator requires Exhibit 21 country text, the corresponding CIK-linked filing metadata, and the independent static haven list; the paper-printed list is not an independent source. Required raw sources: req_comp_tax, req_sec_metadata, req_sec_exhibit_text, req_haven_reference.
